item.description: Norman Grenier was a man of deep faith and boundless generosity, Norm had a gift for making others laugh. He loved praying, helping those in need, riding motorcycles, and spending time with the family he treasured above all else. Read more: Norman Douglas Grenier

item.title: My seven decades in Ocala have shown me our infrastructure is not keeping up with our growth
item.description: "I am a senior citizen born in Ocala and I have to say that you are right on about your complaints. I've grown up here from the 50's, there wasn't anything for young folks to do here. The infrastructure has not kept up with the growth of the area. I have to say, most complaints come from transplants that have moved from big cities to this area. I definitely don't like the complaints that they have brought with them.
